# GleamGuard

> Premium eco-friendly cleaning and pest control services for homes and businesses in Nairobi, Kenya.

GleamGuard delivers trusted, certified, plant-based cleaning and pest control. Licensed, insured, and committed to safe, healthy spaces for families and teams.
